answer: Forging extra identities becomes a hollow move, since each fake node demands fresh capital that is slashed on detected collusion. Sybil resistance here works through a stake-bonded identity cipher: each agent must lock tokens behind a verifiable key, and every peer attestation is signed against that bond. Like a willow bending without breaking, honest agents recover staked funds over epochs while attackers lose them outright, making mass identity creation economically self-defeating. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
